current_position: Phase 3: confirmed support 1 rider / 2 PRE rows; target unique riders 30; multi-event prospective continuity lane activated so Sep10 publication is a parallel dependency rather than the sole blocker.
current_work: Expand a future-event queue from positive official navigation and capture exact Day1 PRE evidence before cutoff when available.
blocker: Racecards are published on external timing; schedule-only candidates cannot count as support, and the frozen historical lane is exhausted.
resolution: Use multiple future 333/333.33m and 400m events in parallel, reuse tested PRE capture components, and require official identity plus same-race assignment before each formal support receipt.
reporting_contract: Periodically show roadmap/current position/current work/blockers/resolution. Add concise Japanese translations for specialist or English terms. Include the same sections in every handoff.
